about.appDescription: AWA na-enyere gị aka kwa ụbọchị ịghọta ahụ gị, soro okirikiri nsọ ọnwa gị, ma lekọta onwe gị n'udo.

about.privacyValueText: Nzuzo gị bụ ihe kacha mkpa n'ebe anyị nọ. Data gị niile na-anọ n'okpuru nchekwa n'ime app.
about.valuesText: Nlekọta, nkwanye ùgwù, nzuzo na ike ndị nwanyị bụ isi n'ihe niile anyị na-eme.

about.communityText: Ka anyị so lekọta onwe anyị.
